name: Garrow
title: Charter carter boss
examine: Twenty years on the wains and six of them on the road. A tally in his head and a place that is not a place on the clerk's board. He does not look at the bank.
lines: Stone, field, forty, no vendor. That is the entry. It was lying on a bank and nobody was standing on the bank.
They do not come to the yard. They do not ask. I have a schedule. Those three things together are what a carter calls a field.
My best cart is in their wall. I have not gone across. I would have to say what was on it, and I have a schedule.
